description: Base de Datos Histórica desde 2013 a 2021 de Cobertura Banda Ancha Fija y Móvil is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio para la Transformación Digital y de la Función Pública. Base de Datos Histórica 2013-2021 de Cobertura Banda Ancha Fija y Móvil, incluye las tecnologías Fibra Óptica, ADSL, LTE y 5G entre otras. Coverage: Ministerio para la Transformación Digital y de la Función Pública. The publisher named on the listing is Ministerio para la Transformación Digital y de la Función Pública. Its keywords include Fibra Óptica, LTE, Telecomunicaciones, cobertura. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SHEET. The listing shows 2022-12-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://datos.gob.es/es/aviso-legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
